ITEM 1 | Flatbread wedge at upper right, golden-tan with dark brown charred spots and blistered edges, one triangular piece about 9 cm long, slightly puffed, matte surface, sitting on the plate rim | 45
ITEM 2 | Cooked kale-style leafy greens, dark green curly leaves with pale stems, glossy light sheen from dressing, scattered orange shreds and small pale beige chickpea-like pieces, mounded about 10 cm across at upper left-center | 70
ITEM 3 | Diced red pepper pieces, bright red with soft cut edges, a few small chunks among the greens | 12
ITEM 4 | Shredded orange carrot strips, thin and slightly limp, scattered among the greens | 8
ITEM 5 | Light tan grain mixture (appears to be cooked whole grains with small dark flecks), loose and slightly moist, forming a mound about 8 cm wide under the greens | 85
ITEM 6 | Two golden corn cob rounds with yellow kernels and pale cut centers, each about 4 cm across and 3 cm thick, upright disc pieces on the right edge of the plate | 60
ITEM 7 | Third corn cob round, same yellow kernel pattern, about 4 cm across, slightly separated from the other discs on the right | 30
ITEM 8 | Fourth corn cob round, same yellow kernel pattern, about 4 cm across, lower right of the stack | 30
ITEM 9 | Baked fish fillet portion at lower center, flaky pale white-cream flesh topped with a creamy white sauce and green herb flecks, about 9 cm by 6 cm and 2 cm thick | 110
ITEM 10 | Second fish fillet portion beside the first, pale flesh with a thick creamy white topping and dark green leafy garnish underneath, about 8 cm by 6 cm | 95
ITEM 11 | Creamy white sauce or dressing, glossy and thick, spread over the fish fillets and partly on the greens | 25
